feature_idea: Add dark mode to our mobile app

research.market_insights: Users expect dark mode for comfort in low-light environments and battery savings on OLED screens.
research.competitive_analysis: Most top productivity and social apps offer dark mode with auto-schedule support.
research.research_summary: Dark mode is a baseline expectation for mobile UX; competitive parity and accessibility improvements are strong drivers.

strategy.vision: Deliver a comfortable, accessible viewing experience that improves retention and engagement.
strategy.strategic_alignment: Supports retention and accessibility roadmap initiatives.

architecture.technical_feasibility: Feasible with theme tokens and OS theme detection.
architecture.recommended_approach: Implement theme tokens, add system preference detection, and provide manual toggle.
architecture.architecture_notes: Ensure contrast ratios and test across devices.
